entities.description: A young boy with curly light brown hair smiles broadly while holding a black DSLR camera with both hands in front of his chest. He wears a blue and white plaid button-down shirt over a white t-shirt, with a blank white ID badge hanging from a lanyard around his neck and a camera strap over his shoulders.

A young girl with long brown hair is seated at a wooden desk, wearing a white short-sleeved polo shirt and writing in an open notebook with a black pen. She is looking down with a focused expression, and the arm of an adult in a grey sweater is partially visible on the left side of the frame.

A young boy with short brown hair is seated at a desk, looking down while writing on a white sheet of paper with a black pen. He is wearing a light blue button-down shirt with a white lanyard around his neck.

A close-up, out-of-focus shot of a young girl with long, straight black hair and bangs, wearing a white collared shirt, positioned in the background between two other individuals. In the foreground, the shoulder of a person wearing a blue and white plaid shirt is visible, with a hand resting on it, while the back of a boy's head is visible on the left.

foreground_elements.right: shoulder of person in blue plaid shirt with hand on it

entities.description: A smiling woman with long brown hair stands next to a young boy with curly brown hair, both holding black DSLR cameras with straps around their necks. The woman wears a white button-down shirt under a light grey cardigan and beige trousers, while the boy wears a blue and white plaid shirt over a white t-shirt with a white ID badge hanging from a lanyard.
